inspection_method: Manual visual inspection of actual images; no OCR or image editing. Native source successfully viewed in original detail after a preserved-original preview rendered only a white strip. Native image was also emitted with generatedImage.

views.observations: Three intact horizontal phrase groups. Upper-left first word is heavy; second begins farther right and is smaller; final word is farther right and lighter. Natural Hangul remains legible. Faint mottling appears in the white field and black fills at native size.
All three words readable without zoom. The first word attracts first glance; normal top-to-bottom order is clear. Generous line intervals and rightward offsets remain distinct.
The exact words can still be read. Strong first-word weight and lighter final word persist; the three groups occupy the middle half of the frame.

retained_defects_uncertainties.impact: Strict plainness of the field is not certified; independent reviewers should decide whether this finish remains within letters-and-whitespace constraint.
